broadcasts.message: Final normalize.js: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to one ASCII space, trim. Non-string returns empty string. No word changes. Team complete.

Final tokenizer.js: calls injected normalize(text) once, extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes using exact regex, returns array in input order or empty array. No stopwords, preserves negation, no shadowing. Ready for integration.

Final pipeline.js is complete. It calls injected tokenize(text) once, builds frequencies with Object.create(null) to safely handle prototype names, and returns exactly {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. All modules are aligned and ready for production.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 4 final: normalize.js complete and unchanged. All modules aligned with spec. No further changes required.
private_memories.tokenizer: Final round: tokenizer.js is complete and unchanged. It correctly calls injected normalize(text) once, applies exact regex /[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*/g, and returns match array or empty array. No shadowing of normalize. Handles empty strings, punctuation, whitespace, and preserves order. All peers aligned.
